chapter_title: Concerning the Five Forms that exist in the Rulers of Darkness
chapter_note: This chapter is dominated by the oldest teaching substrate. It systematically maps the five forms of the ruler of Darkness onto the five worlds (fire, wind, smoke, darkness, water) using zoomorphic correspondences (lion-faced, eagle-faced, dragon-faced, fish-form, daemon-form), then enumerates two sets of three qualities/capacities. Gardner notes comparison with Chapter 6, confirming this is the same cosmological-correspondential tradition. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system throughout ¶1-11. Only ¶12-13 shift to exhortation/devotional closure addressed to 'my beloved ones.' Minimal editorial fatigue. The teaching structure is clean: five forms (¶2-3), three qualities (¶4-7), three more qualities (¶8-11), then editorial closure.

paragraphs.core_text: Five forms exist in his body, corresponding to (the archetype) of the five creations that exist in the five worlds of darkness.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue frame: 'Once again, the apostle is sitting among the congregation. He says to his disciples: Consider the ruler, the leader of all the powers of darkness. Now,' — formulaic session-opening attribution and imperative address to audience.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Opening formula 'Once again, the apostle is sitting among the congregation' is standard dialogue frame. 'Consider the ruler' is an imperative address form. But the substantive cosmological statement about five forms corresponding to five creations in five worlds is the teaching thesis — it defines the entire chapter's structure.

paragraphs.core_text: Indeed, his head is lion-faced, which came about from the world of fire. His wings and his shoulders are eagle-faced, after the likeness of the children of the wind. His hands and his feet are daemons, after the likeness of the children of the world of smoke. His belly is dragon-faced, after the likeness of the world of darkness. His tail is the form of the fish, which belongs to the world of the children of water. These five shapes are in him, and they came from the five creations of the five worlds of darkness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Quintessential substrate: zoomorphic-realm correspondences. Lion-faced → fire, eagle-faced → wind, daemons → smoke, dragon-faced → darkness, fish → water. Body-part mapping (head, wings/shoulders, hands/feet, belly, tail) onto five worlds. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system. The diagnostic markers lion-faced, eagle-faced, dragon-faced, fish are all present. Compare Chapter 6.

paragraphs.core_text: Should he wish, he shall walk on his two feet [ ... ] world of smoke. Also, when he wants, he shall [ ... ] four [ ... ] on his hands and feet [ ... ] like the children of fire. Should he wish, he shall rise up on his wings, like the children of the wind. Also, should he wish, he shall plunge down to the waters like the children of water. Again, should he wish, he shall crawl on his belly like the children of darkness. These five shapes are in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the five-form mapping but now describes the ruler's modes of locomotion corresponding to each form. Each capacity maps to a cosmic realm. Lacunae damage the first two entries but the structure is clear. Systematic, impersonal, process-oriented.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, there are three other (qualities) in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Transitional enumeration statement introducing a new teaching structure — three qualities after the five forms. This is the substrate's organizational voice.
Heavily damaged by lacuna. Enumeration marker 'The first:' preserved. Only fragments survive but the teaching structure is visible.

paragraphs.core_text: The second: Shall a [ ... ] his magic arts. When he wishes, he shall make an invocation over himself, and hide from his powers. When he wants, he shall show himself to them and strike a death-blow by his magic arts. Any word he might utter at that moment, he shall [wreak magic] by it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The editorial_bridge score (14.29) is triggered by 'magic arts' vocabulary, but in context this describes what the ruler of Darkness IS and CAN DO within the cosmic system — his second faculty. Compare the explicit substrate identification in the instructions: 'The King of Darkness wounds and kills by the word of his magic arts — describes what his second faculty IS within the degree structure.' Both sides of the mapping stay cosmic. No contemporary application.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: His body is strong, a[1]] [ ... ] nails and claws of his powers are not able to penetrate it. No iron nor copper body will equal him [ ... ]; they will not be able to destroy him, because he was formed and fashioned from the hard-hearted counsel of Matter, the mother of demons and fiends.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third quality: invulnerability. Metal-body reference (iron, copper) stays within the cosmic register. 'Matter, the mother of demons and fiends' is a cosmological designation — a personified cosmic entity functioning as origin-agent. Both sides remain within the system.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, there are three others in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second transitional enumeration statement introducing another set of three qualities. Parallel structure to ¶4. Substrate organizational voice.

paragraphs.core_text: When he wants, his fire shall {blaze), and his entire body be made like the [ ... of] fire.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First of the second set of three: fire capacity. The ruler's body corresponds to the element of fire. Cosmic mapping, both sides internal.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, when he wishes, he shall send out frost, and his entire body freezes like a [ ... of] snow.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second of the second set: frost/cold capacity. Cosmic elemental correspondence. Parallel syntactic structure to ¶9.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: Whenever his powers are stood before him, he shall look at them and understand; for [whatever ex]ists in their heart he shall understand, what is in their heart and their face so long as they are stood before him. When they retreat before him and distance themselves from him, he shall not understand what is in their heart. There is no life in him whatsoever, but his 'life' is the bile of anger that is apparent on his face and in his fear. Shall a [ ... ] destruction that is establ[ished be]fore him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third of the second set: limited perception — understands his powers only when they face him, not when they retreat. Then a crucial cosmological statement: 'There is no life in him whatsoever, but his life is the bile of anger.' This describes what the ruler IS at the deepest level — an absence of life, an appearance only. Both sides of the mapping remain within the cosmic system. This is the substrate's characteristic impersonal voice describing the nature of Darkness.

Clear shift to devotional closure. 'my beloved ones' is a diagnostic exhortation marker. Direct address to community, imperative voice ('do not lay up/on yourselves'), moral application of the preceding teaching. The teaching about the ruler's forms is now being APPLIED to audience behavior — classic devotional wrapper.

Continues exhortation with eschatological promise ('inherit life for ever and ever'). 'Mind of truth that has been manifested to you' addresses the audience. 'become zealous and perfect' is imperative moral instruction. Standard devotional closure appended to the substrate teaching sequence.
